test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 11 August 2004 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 February 2006?
solution:
Given: 11 August 2004 was Wednesday.

Then, 11 August 2005 was Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.

Now, from 11 August 2005 to 11 February 2006 

= 20(Aug) + 30(Sept) + 31(Oct) + 30(Nov) + 31(Dec) + 31(Jan) + 11(Feb)

= 184 days.

And, Total odd days in 184 days = 184/7 = 26 weeks and 2 odd days.

So, **11 February 2006** will be → **Thursday **+ 2 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
